summary: Backend API testing for Zenkai eCommerce. 33/34 tests passed (97% success). Comprehensive coverage of products (list/filter/search/categories/CRUD), auth (register/login/me/logout/duplicate/unauth), cart, wishlist, checkout, orders, admin (analytics/orders/CRUD guards), newsletter, and auth guards (401/403). One critical bug found in /api/checkout/status/{session_id}.

critical.issue: Returns 500 due to pydantic ValidationError in emergentintegrations.payments.stripe.checkout.get_checkout_status -> CheckoutStatusResponse: 'metadata Input should be a valid dictionary' (receives StripeObject instead of dict). This blocks the order completion flow (frontend cannot poll payment status after Stripe redirect, so cart is never cleared and orders are never created).

action_items: Fix GET /api/checkout/status/{session_id} 500 error. Root cause: emergentintegrations library's CheckoutStatusResponse model rejects Stripe metadata which arrives as StripeObject (not a dict). Workaround options: (a) wrap the stripe.get_checkout_status call in try/except and fall back to reading payment_transactions from DB, (b) use stripe SDK directly to retrieve the session and serialize metadata via dict(session.metadata or {}), (c) monkey-patch / pre-process metadata before the library converts the response. Recommend option (b) for reliability.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 700+ lines — split into routers/ (products, auth, cart, checkout, admin) for maintainability.
Cookies use secure=True, samesite='none' — correct for cross-site preview URL, but no CSRF protection on POST endpoints; consider double-submit cookie pattern.
No rate-limiting/brute-force protection on /api/auth/login (playbook requires 5-fail lockout). Not implemented.
Admin password is updated to hash on every startup if mismatch — idempotent seed is correct.
GET /api/cart enriches with product details inside a Python loop (N+1 query); acceptable for small carts but consider $lookup aggregation if scaled.
/api/upload accepts any image MIME based on extension; consider validating actual content-type.
No input validation for product 'category' against allowed enum — invalid categories can be inserted.
No pagination metadata on /api/products list response (only limit query param).

rca_of_the_issue: RCA for /api/checkout/status/{session_id}: emergentintegrations==pydantic v2 builds CheckoutStatusResponse(metadata=session.metadata). Stripe returns session.metadata as a stripe.StripeObject (a dict-like but not isinstance dict), and pydantic v2 strict typing rejects it (dict_type error). Reproduction: 1) login as user 2) POST /api/cart 3) POST /api/checkout/session returns 200 with session_id 4) GET /api/checkout/status/{session_id} -> 500. Mitigation: bypass the library helper for status polling or coerce metadata to dict before instantiating the model.
